title: Diagnostics export confirmation

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Diagnostics export must present an explicit redacted-support disclosure before building or presenting an export report.
Cancelling the diagnostics disclosure must stop before report export and must not write or present a support artifact.
Confirmed diagnostics export must build only an allowlisted per-export aliased support artifact and must reject or alias sensitive account, host, path, session, auth, and token-like evidence.

targetSurface: CodexPill Diagnostics menu action, confirmation flow, and diagnostic report builder

nonClaims: Does not prove live NSSavePanel rendering or file writing.
Does not inspect real local logs, auth snapshots, SSH output, UserDefaults, or Codex session history.
